literal: Even than ambrosia, exceedingly sweet indeed is one's own children's small hands mixed porridge.
translation: The simple porridge stirred by the tiny hands of one's own children is far sweeter than the nectar of the gods.
modern: தம்முடைய குழந்தைகளின் சிறிய கைகளால் பிசையப்பட்ட உணவு, அமிழ்தத்தை விட மிகவும் இனிமையானதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet captures the pure joy of parenthood through a simple, everyday image. It states that ordinary food becomes sweeter than the mythical nectar of the gods when it has been playfully mixed by the tiny hands of one's own children. The word 'அமிழ்து' represents the ultimate delicacy, yet it is surpassed by the emotional sweetness of a child's touch. The imagery of 'சிறுகை அளாவிய கூழ்' evokes the messy, endearing reality of feeding toddlers, highlighting how parental love transforms the mundane into the extraordinary.
